    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_40/test_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_40/test_10.csv"
]

# Note: Source9_40_4 and Source9_40_9 are NOT included in the UNION operation as per operation_history.

# Columns to keep and their target types
target_columns = ['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd']

# Function to load and transform each source file
def load_and_transform(file_path):
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Select only the target columns
    df = df[target_columns].copy()
    
    # Convert company_permalink to string (should already be string, but enforce)
    df['company_permalink'] = df['company_permalink'].astype(str)
    
    # Convert funded_year to integer (some sources have float, e.g. 2012.0)
    # First fill NaNs if any with 0 or drop them (assuming no NaNs in funded_year)
    # But safer to drop rows with NaN in funded_year or raised_amount_usd
    df = df.dropna(subset=['funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd'])
    
    # Convert funded_year to int
    df['funded_year'] = df['funded_year'].astype(int)
    
    # Convert raised_amount_usd to int (some are float)
    df['raised_amount_usd'] = df['raised_amount_usd'].astype(int)
    
    return df

# Load and transform all source files in the UNION list
